## A fourth stale prose claim in the same docblock family — adopting it here so it has a successor

Surfaced by the objectui#9355 round-2 dev as `noted, not filed`, with the explicit warning that **if this card did not exist it would have no successor and nothing would re-derive the claim**. This card exists, so it adopts it.

### The claim

`scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, in the prose above `BASELINE` (near `:358` on `main` today — ⚠️ **anchor on the text, not the line**; objectui#9429 is in the merge queue and will shift it):

> ⛔ None of that is weighed by the constant below, and what it costs gzipped is **UNMEASURED rather than small — nobody has built `77b2a18a16`**.

### It is false, and was already false when it was written

objectui#9209's own comment `5651315065` (2026-09-13T05:10:45Z) carries a section headed **"The reading on `77b2a18a16`"**:

```
[plugin emit-eager-closure-report] eager closure: 51/528 chunks, 3165008 bytes gzipped (3090.8 KB)
```

> From the JSON directly: `eagerGzipBytes` **3,165,008**, `eagerChunkCount` 51 of 528, `eagerRawBytes` 10,915,262, and `files[].gzipBytes` sums to `eagerGzipBytes` exactly

⇒ **somebody did build `77b2a18a16`**, in a dedicated worktree, with the report's own internal-consistency condition checked. ⭐ And round 1 of objectui#9355 quoted that very figure back — so the sentence was contradicted by a card in this same lane before anyone noticed the sentence.

I verified the comment myself rather than taking it second-hand: it contains `3,165,008`, `3165008`, `77b2a18a16` and `755d34a5f`.

### Why it belongs on this card rather than its own

Same file, same docblock family, same defect class: **prose stating a fact derived once and never re-derived**. This card is already about shas in that docblock whose labels no longer match reality; "nobody has built X" is the same failure with a verb instead of a label. Filing it separately would split one repair across two cards — and 创业阶段不扩散.

⇒ **added to this card's acceptance as item 5:**

5. The `nobody has built \`77b2a18a16\`` claim is corrected or removed. If a figure is quoted, it carries **where it was measured** (objectui#9209, `5651315065`) so the next reader can check it instead of re-deriving it — or it is deleted, per this file's own anti-stale-prose discipline. ⛔ Do not simply flip the sentence to name 3,165,008 without its provenance; that is how the original got here.

⚠️ **Serial note, unchanged**: this file is touched by PR objectui#9429 (in the merge queue now) and PR objectui#9488 (held, blocked on objectui#9492). ⛔ Do not dispatch this against either branch, and re-derive every line number after objectui#9429 lands.

## Ruling — `pm:queue`, `priority:p3` — ⛔ but **NOT dispatchable today** (serial)

**The grade.** Authority: 「`pm:queue` 也收…与实现未被裁错的说明书脱节(修文档)」. `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` is not mis-ruled; one evidence table inside it names four trees a reader cannot re-resolve, and one of those shas does not exist at all. Named landing point (`:883`–`:888`, plus the four further citations at `:823`, `:957`, `:1142`, `:1249`), a population counted in words with all three buckets exercised, a named and excluded false positive (`3345000`, a byte count in prose), and a suggested acceptance. Nothing to ask.

## ⚠️ The serial conflict — measured, and it is why this is not going out this round

`GET /pulls/{n}/files` over all **8** open PRs. **Two** of them already hold this card's landing file:

| PR | state | files of interest |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **#9488** | draft — **HELD**, blocked on objectui#9492 (`domain:ui`, unassigned) | `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` |
| **#8941** | ready — `lucide-react 1.31.0 → 1.43.0`, 38 files | `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` |

**Control on the same command**: the identical filter returned **none** for #9515, #9514, #9466, #9391, #9378 ⇒ the filter discriminates, so these two hits are readings.

⇒ 同文件串行,⛔ not parallel work. This card edits a docblock table; #8941 is a dependency bump that moves budget figures in the same file. Dispatching now buys a merge conflict on prose, which is the cheapest possible thing to avoid and the most annoying to resolve.

**Dispatch-when:** `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` is held by **no** open pull request — i.e. both objectui#8941 and objectui#9488 are merged or closed. ⛔ #9488's own unblocking (objectui#9492) is **not** a precondition of this card; it is only the reason #9488 is sitting still.

⚠️ Note for whoever eventually takes it: #8941 may itself move the numbers this table reports. Re-derive the table's readings on the tree you actually land on — ⛔ do not carry this card's figures forward unchecked. Re-deriving a figure that was derived once is the entire subject of this card.
